title: Element material blocks
description: Makes copper, iron, gold and diamond to element blocks from Minecraft Education edition. Also changes iron golems to look like they were made from element iron blocks (optional addon which requires CEM)
body:
# _~~Why my iron golem doesn't work~~_ ## Well now it does! ---

![Pack title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a787367bad2193e0e208912180f0fb2269238941.png)

Preview ![Before blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609457981a62e6e5301df83d37f034a4e1d47d76.jpeg) **Before** ![After blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04c47716c035fda0acbae713b50a015c532dc03c.jpeg) **After** ![Before golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/409fef0fd4ad3b0effd3c6308dc3b3d43ca7ba14.png) **Before** ![After golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a4e31c9429a12aea44842d9bf0a48c2dc88b162.png) **After**

This pack changes iron, copper, gold and diamond blocks to look like their corresponding element blocks from Minecraft Education edition. Also it makes iron golem to look like he's made from ferum, but that requires mods which enable CEM support. But don't worry, if you don't want you can install version without him.


[![Entity Model Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d79bad19d862aa4923ef3b6c1876c9f867a517fc_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) <- if you want custom golem


Terms of use - Block textures are owned by Mojang AB and Microsoft. I do not claim ownership of those textures. - Iron golem is made by me. You are allowed to use it and repurpose them for any non-commercial use. However if you want to publish something with it please message me and credit me in pack description/credit.txt , especially if you want to use it for commercial use (but that's not likely).
